# DuneSQL queries for `Fixture-Nest` on mainnet

Generated by `nuthatch emit dune` (RFC-0055). Each file is one DuneSQL `SELECT` over `dune.fixture_ns.<table>`, which must hold the nest's rows with every column `varchar` except `block_number`, `log_index`, `_seq` and `block_timestamp`. Regenerate rather than edit.
